notes: Cumulative Safety Tracker build. Preserves v2.11.71 approval reliability and all prior v2.11.65-v2.11.70 features. Fixes modal validation/warning messages being hidden behind dialogs and clarifies that Group TBT settings apply only to optional automatic refresher scheduling, not normal TBT assignment. Rebuilds the controlled document-set folder editor into clear mobile sections. Overall annual-review responsibility and default file-review responsibility can now be assigned using the normal targets: Everyone, Departments, Positions, Groups or specific people. Keeps acknowledgement audience separate from review responsibility and retains advanced annual/periodic rules in a collapsed Advanced section. Database support for flexible responsibility targets is included and already applied.
